title_zh: 天津海河传媒中心原党委书记王奕接受纪律审查和监察调查
title_en: Wang Yi, Former Party Secretary of Tianjin Haihe Media Center, Under Investigation for Discipline Violations
summary_zh: 2026年8月18日，据天津市纪委监委消息，天津海河传媒中心原党委书记王奕涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: On August 18, 2026, Wang Yi, former Party Secretary of Tianjin Haihe Media Center, is under disciplinary review and supervision investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, according to Tianjin disciplinary authorities.
